name: Alaska

filing.name: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing

labor.name: Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development

llcReport.deadline: January 2 of every second year after formation

penalty.note: $25 for each year or part of a year delinquent; Alaska statutes also authorize an additional charge of 10% of the filing fee.

corpReport.deadline: January 2 of every second year after formation

penalty.note: Penalty for failure to file a required biennial report.

entityTax: Corporate income tax (no individual income tax)

salesTax.alternative: Alaska has no statewide sales tax; many boroughs and cities levy their own and sellers into Alaska register with the Alaska Remote Seller Sales Tax Commission (ARSSTC).

unemployment.note: Employees also contribute; the 1.00% minimum applies to employers.

businessLicense.title: Alaska state business license
businessLicense.authority: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing

penalty.note: No separate state business-license late penalty is listed; a lapsed license may be renewed during the two-year lapse window, and after two years a new license is required.

local.title: Borough/city business license
local.description: Local licenses and sales tax registration where the municipality has them.

industry.contractor: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
industry.childCare: Alaska Department of Health, Child Care Program Office

cannabis.regulator: Alaska Alcohol and Marijuana Control Office (Marijuana Control Board)
